sources.title: Collaborative Insight engine health monitoring
sources.supports: named fleet-monitoring deployment, Fleet Monitor X and company-reported activity

financial_anchor.caveat: Total GAAP revenue $13.3bn; adjusted revenue $12.6bn and adjusted operating profit $2.7bn are separate non-GAAP measures; CES revenue $9.7bn is a segment figure.

ai_claim.claim: Collaborative Insight uses advanced analytics to monitor 44,000+ commercial engines and names Fleet Monitor X, 750+ customers and maintenance recommendations.
ai_claim.stage: E2 scoped company-reported deployment; no E3 controlled effectiveness
ai_claim.scope: engine-health monitoring and fleet maintenance recommendations
ai_claim.limitation: Activity and outcome figures are company-reported and lack a matched fleet/cash comparator.

strongest_counterevidence.claim: Service volume and price drove results, while casting bottlenecks led to a proposed $11.75bn CPP acquisition funded with cash/debt; supply execution dominates near-term economics.
strongest_counterevidence.limitation: Ordinary operating drivers block AI attribution.

rights_limit: Airline/operator, JV partner, defense and licensed technical data is contract-bound; cross-fleet training rights undisclosed.
materiality_summary: $455m annual pre-tax (5% of FY2025 adjusted operating profit); no E4 bridge.

arithmetic.inputs: assumed 2bn eligible cost, 15% efficiency, 60% realization, 50% retention, 80m cost

g2_provisional: Incomplete: named E2 deployment without controlled safety-adjusted effectiveness or retained economics.
